hook: What happens if an astronaut cries in space?
fact: Without gravity, tears don't fall. They form a sticky liquid sphere on your eyeballs that stings and temporarily blinds you until you wipe it away.

topic: Why Does Stomach Acid Not Melt Your Own Organs?
hook: Your stomach acid is strong enough to dissolve razor blades. So why doesn't it melt you?
fact: Stomach hydrochloric acid has a pH of 1.5. You survive because your stomach lining secretes a thick bicarbonate mucus barrier and replaces its entire cellular lining every 3 to 4 days.

topic: What If You Touched Aerogel With Bare Hands?
hook: This material is 99.8% air, yet can stop a blowtorch flame at 1000 degrees Celsius.
fact: Aerogel, dubbed 'frozen smoke', is the world's lightest solid. It feels like brittle styrofoam and creates an almost impenetrable thermal barrier due to nano-porous silica traps.

topic: What Really Happens When You Get Brain Freeze?
hook: Why does eating ice cream too fast feel like your brain is exploding?
fact: It's called Sphenopalatine Ganglioneuralgia. Rapid cold on your palate triggers the brain's internal carotid artery to violently dilate to keep the brain warm, causing localized pressure and pain.

topic: The Deadliest Sound In The Universe
hook: Did you know a sound wave can literally vaporize your entire body?
fact: At 194 decibels in Earth's atmosphere, sound stops being sound and turns into a catastrophic supersonic shockwave. A Krakatoa blast at 310 dB circled Earth 4 times.

topic: Why Can't Anything Move Faster Than Light?
hook: Why is 300,000 km per second the ultimate cosmic speed limit?
fact: Einstein's relativity shows as an object accelerates, its relativistic mass and energy requirement climb toward infinity. Reaching light speed requires infinite energy, which the entire universe doesn't possess.

topic: Why Do We Dream And Instantly Forget Them?
hook: Why do you forget 95% of your dreams within 5 minutes of waking up?
fact: During REM sleep, neurotransmitters norepinephrine and dopamine drop to minimal levels, effectively disabling your hippocampus from converting short-term dream memories into long-term storage.

topic: What If The Moon Suddenly Vanished?
hook: What would happen if the Moon disappeared right this second?
fact: Within 24 hours, ocean tides collapse by 67%. Over decades, Earth's 23.5-degree axial tilt destabilizes, causing extreme climate shifts from freezing poles to scorching deserts.

topic: How Does Anesthesia Actually Shut Off Consciousness?
hook: When doctors put you under anesthesia, you aren't actually sleeping.
fact: General anesthesia disrupts electrical signaling across cortical networks, inducing a reversible, pharmacologically controlled coma where neurons stop binding sensory data into conscious awareness.

topic: What Is The Coldest Temperature In The Universe?
hook: The coldest spot in the universe isn't deep space—it's right here on Earth.
fact: Absolute zero is -273.15°C (0 Kelvin), where atomic motion halts. Deep space sits at 2.7 Kelvin, but MIT and NASA laboratories have chilled atoms to mere billionths of a Kelvin.

topic: Why Does The Ocean Never Run Out Of Salt?
hook: Every year, rivers dump 4 billion tons of salt into the sea. Why doesn't it become solid salt?
fact: Hydrothermal vents and mineral precipitation remove mineral ions at the exact rate rivers supply them, maintaining chemical equilibrium for hundreds of millions of years.

topic: What Happens To A Body In Vacuum Without A Spacesuit?
hook: Would your body explode if exposed to the vacuum of space?
fact: You don't explode. Human skin is too tough. Instead, dissolved nitrogen boils in your blood within 10 seconds, oxygen leaves your lungs, and you lose consciousness in 15 seconds.
